body: Dutch flag carrier KLM has commenced its first long-haul Airbus A350-900 service, operating from Amsterdam to Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ), Canada's largest and busiest airport. The airline will initially operate the route with the aircraft up to five times weekly, before moving the rotation to a daily service next March. Toronto is the first of many new A350 destinations for the SkyTeam partner, with plans to serve Montreal and multiple destinations in Africa.

KLM has operated flights from Amsterdam to Toronto for more than half a century, with this year marking 52 years of service to the city and more than 75 years to Canada; the airline first commenced services on April 29, 1974. Flight KL691 is scheduled to depart Amsterdam at 1:30 PM for the over eight-hour journey across the North Atlantic, arriving in Toronto at 4:40 PM, while return service KL692 departs Toronto just before 7:00 PM and operates overnight for an early morning arrival back in Europe, landing in Amsterdam at 7:05 AM.

KLM has a total of 22 Airbus A350-900s set to be delivered over the next few years, with its first A350-900 delivered on October 2. That aircraft carries the nickname De Nachtwacht, meaning The Night Watch, and had previously been used for crew training and testing, during which time it made multiple round-trip flights to the Norwegian city of Stavanger. The next destination will be Montreal-Trudeau International Airport (YUL), served three times a week, followed by a triangle service from Amsterdam to Kilimanjaro (JRO) and Dar es Salaam (DAR), with Nairobi (NBO) to follow on January 5.

The aircraft operating the first flight, registered PH-ZNA, took its first test flight under French registration F-WZMM on September 4, 2026, according to ch-aviation, and was delivered on October 2. The jet is configured with 331 seats across three classes, including 34 World Business, 26 Premium Comfort and 271 Economy seats, and is equipped with 4K Panasonic Astrova screens, high-speed Wi-Fi via Viasat and built-in Bluetooth audio. These A350s are set to replace KLM's aging Boeing 777-200ER aircraft as well as the remaining A330-200 and A330-300 aircraft, as part of a widebody fleet renewal program.
en.summary: KLM has operated its first long-haul Airbus A350-900 service, from Amsterdam to Toronto, initially up to five times weekly before moving to daily next March, with Montreal and African destinations to follow.
en.title: KLM operates first Airbus A350 flight to Toronto, with Montreal and Africa next

body: 荷蘭皇家航空首班長程空中巴士A350-900航班，今日由阿姆斯特丹飛往加拿大最大、最繁忙的機場多倫多皮爾遜國際機場。初期每週最多營運5班，明年3月起改為每日1班。多倫多是荷航眾多A350新航點中的第一個，後續還計畫飛往蒙特婁與非洲多個目的地。
荷航阿姆斯特丹—多倫多航線已有超過半世紀歷史，今年是通航多倫多52週年、飛往加拿大超過75年，首班服務始於1974年4月29日。KL691預定下午1時30分由阿姆斯特丹出發，橫越北大西洋飛行逾8小時，下午4時40分抵達多倫多；回程KL692於傍晚6時55分由多倫多出發，夜間飛行、清晨7時05分回到阿姆斯特丹。
荷航未來幾年預計共接收22架A350-900，首架已於10月2日交付，暱稱為夜巡，交付前用於機組訓練與測試，期間曾多次往返挪威斯塔萬格。下一個航點是蒙特婁杜魯道國際機場，每週3班；接著是阿姆斯特丹往返吉力馬札羅與三蘭港的三角航線，奈洛比則將於2027年1月5日跟進。
執飛首航的飛機註冊編號為PH-ZNA，2026年9月4日以法國註冊編號F-WZMM首飛，10月2日交付，全機共331席，分為世界商務艙34席、尊尚舒適艙26席與經濟艙271席，配備4K松下Astrova螢幕、Viasat高速無線網路與內建藍牙音訊。這批A350將取代荷航老舊的波音777-200ER與剩餘的A330-200及A330-300，作為廣體機隊更新計畫的一環。
zh.summary: 荷蘭皇家航空首班長程A350-900由阿姆斯特丹飛往多倫多，初期每週最多5班、明年3月起每日營運，後續將延伸至蒙特婁與非洲航點。
